title: Problem Details
description: Learn to use ProblemDetails for standardized error responses.

data.text: **ProblemDetails** is a standardized way to return machine-readable error details in HTTP responses, following RFC 7807.

data.title: Automatic Error Response
data.content: ASP.NET Core automatically returns ProblemDetails for validation failures

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: ASP.NET Core returns them automatically for 400 errors
data.takeaway: ProblemDetails make APIs easier to debug and consume.
